+@tilelang.jit(
+    pass_configs={
+        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
+        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
+    }
+)
+def _unpack_split_experts_kernel(
+    hidden,
+    num_experts,
+    total_padded_tokens,
+    total_valid_tokens,
+    split_m,
+    row_base,
+):
+    block_n = 256
+    threads = 256
+
+    @T.prim_func
+    def kernel(
+        split_output: T.Tensor((num_experts, split_m, hidden), T.float16),
+        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
+        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
+        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
+    ):
+        with T.Kernel(
+            num_experts,
+            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
+            threads=threads,
+        ) as (expert_id, bn):
+            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
+            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
+            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
+            for i, j in T.Parallel(split_m, block_n):
+                global_i = row_base + i
+                if global_i < group_size:
+                    out[padded_start + global_i, bn * block_n + j] = (
+                        split_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
+                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + global_i]
+                    )
+
+    return kernel
+

22-## Workflow Direction Policy
23-
24:- Track experiments by optimization family, not only by sequential version number.
25:- If a direction repeatedly regresses, remains score-neutral within judge noise, or yields only small diminishing gains, mark that family saturated or blocked and switch to a materially different direction.
26:- Do not continue nearby parameter enumeration merely because values remain untested. Revisit a saturated family only when new documentation, measurements, or an architecture change alters its premise.
27:- Current saturated families include simple E64 FC2 chunk enumeration around chunk16 and elementwise block-width enlargement. Following v137-v139, move away from these scheduling probes toward architectural work such as memory-safe FC1 fusion or reliable reduction of dense FC padding computation.

     return kernel
 
 
+
+@tilelang.jit(
+    pass_configs={
+        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
+        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
+    }
+)
+def _unpack_split_experts_kernel(
+    hidden,
+    num_experts,
+    total_padded_tokens,
+    total_valid_tokens,
+    split_m,
+    row_base,
+):
+    block_n = 256
+    threads = 256
+
+    @T.prim_func
+    def kernel(
+        split_output: T.Tensor((num_experts, split_m, hidden), T.float16),
+        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
+        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
+        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
+    ):
+        with T.Kernel(
+            num_experts,
+            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
+            threads=threads,
+        ) as (expert_id, bn):
+            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
+            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
+            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
+            for i, j in T.Parallel(split_m, block_n):
+                global_i = row_base + i
+                if global_i < group_size:
+                    out[padded_start + global_i, bn * block_n + j] = (
+                        split_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
+                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + global_i]
+                    )
+
+    return kernel
+
